catalog.summary: Every item the game knows, or the ones carrying a tag.
params: optional: only the items of that tag

tags.summary: The tags of an item, or whether it carries one of them.
tags.returns: `list` of tags, or `bool` when a tag is given.

max_stack.returns: `num` — the maximum size of a stack.

crafting_remainder.summary: What is left in the grid after using that item in a recipe.
crafting_remainder.returns: `str` — the name of what remains, `null` when nothing does.

name.summary: The name of the item as the game shows it, translated.
params: the item, as a name or as a triple

recipes.summary: The recipes producing an item: ingredients, result and kind.
recipes.returns: `list` — one entry per recipe, `null` when there is none.

components.summary: Every data component of an item, as a map from id to value.
params: optional: with `true` it reads the components the **kind of item** has, not the ones this stack carries
components.returns: `map` — from component id to its value.
components.note: Since 1.20.5 an item is an id plus typed components, not free-form NBT. Reading through the raw NBT still works for what is in the NBT, but it cannot tell an absent value from one equal to the default.

component.summary: A single data component of an item.
params: the id of the component, as `'minecraft:damage'`
optional: with `true` it reads the value of the kind of item
component.returns: the value of the component, `null` when the stack does not carry it.

set_component.summary: The item with one component changed, or removed when the value is `null`.
params: the new value; `null` removes the component
set_component.returns: `list` — a **copy** of the item with the change; the original is untouched.
set_component.note: A value that makes no sense for that component is refused right away by the codec, with a `TypeMismatchError` — the alternative is a broken item discovered much later, when somebody tries to use it.

component_catalog.summary: The ids of every data component this game knows.
